atlasNetwork.travelLimits: Journey times are a guide. They exclude ferries and don't account for hills, opening hours or temporary route changes. Routes aren't checked for step-free access.
atlasNetwork.reachMeaning: We estimate journeys on mapped roads and paths, then use the population grid to estimate residents within the combined catchment. Overlapping catchments count once. The figures do not show visits or guarantee access.

atlasNetwork.populationMethod: {source} estimates residents for {year}. Cells crossing a boundary are allocated by intersecting area, assuming residents are spread uniformly within each cell. Known zero cells count as zero; NoData remains unknown.
atlasNetwork.routingMethod: Valhalla follows mapped OpenStreetMap roads and paths towards each library. The profile uses a base speed of {speed} km/h; route costs also affect journey time.
atlasNetwork.libraryScope: This calculation uses {count, plural, one {# eligible library} other {# eligible libraries}} belonging to the selected service and matching the applied filters. Other services are excluded, including libraries across the boundary. Libraries belonging to this service may lie outside the reporting area. Map visibility does not determine eligibility.
atlasNetwork.boundaryMethod: The denominator is the modelled population inside {name}, using the union of the service’s reporting districts. It stays fixed when the map moves or library filters change. This boundary is inferred from library locations, not an authoritative service catchment.
atlasNetwork.exportHint: CSV provides a table of results. GeoJSON includes catchment boundaries. Analysis JSON includes the selection, unrounded estimates and source versions.
atlasNetwork.boundaryNote: District boundaries are generalised map boundaries, so estimates near their edges are approximate.
atlasNetwork.selectionChanged: Library filters changed. Update coverage to calculate this selection; the previous figures are no longer shown.
atlasNetwork.missingReportingPopulation: The population grid does not cover this reporting area completely. Its population denominator, coverage percentages and residents beyond each time remain unknown. Community comparisons need a complete denominator.
atlasNetwork.gridResolution: {metres} m cells in an equal-area projection.
atlasNetwork.unknownGrid: Grid resolution is not supplied in this result.
atlasNetwork.networkSnap: Each library needs a suitable mapped route within 100 metres of its recorded location. Individual snap distances are not retained in network results.
atlasNetwork.singleTimeExplanation: To keep this calculation manageable, Reach generates only the selected travel time for this service. Choose Calculate coverage after changing the time. Smaller services include all four times.

atlasAnalysis.surfaceCoverage: Population data covers {percent}% of this area
atlasAnalysis.reachRateLimit: Please wait a moment before checking again.
atlasAnalysis.densityFilterNote: Library filters don't change population density.
atlasAnalysis.densityExplanation: See how many people live in each area, on average, per square kilometre.
atlasAnalysis.selectArea: Select an area on the map to see its population and where the figures come from.
atlasAnalysis.densityMethod: We divide an area's population by its size in square kilometres, including inland water. This gives an average for the whole area. Some neighbourhoods will have more people per square kilometre than others.
atlasAnalysis.densityCoverage: Country populations come from the World Bank. UK district estimates come from the Office for National Statistics (ONS). We add district totals from the same year to form county groups. These groups follow our directory's district boundaries, which can differ from ceremonial counties.
atlasAnalysis.chooseLibrary: Select a library on the map to see how many people could reach it.
atlasAnalysis.reachExplanation: See how many people live within a 5, 10, 15 or 30-minute walk or bike ride of this library.
atlasAnalysis.reachAllowance: You've used this hour's allowance for new Reach calculations. Try again in the next hour.
atlasAnalysis.reachUnavailable: We couldn't calculate Reach right now. Please try again.
atlasAnalysis.calculatingReach: Working out how far people could travel to this library. This may take a moment. You can keep exploring while we calculate.
atlasAnalysis.cumulativeResidents: People who could reach this library
atlasAnalysis.partialPopulation: Population data is missing for part of this area, so we can't show a reliable total for every journey time.
atlasAnalysis.reachAssumptions: Journey times are a guide. They exclude ferries and don't account for hills, opening hours or temporary route changes. Routes aren't checked for step-free access.
atlasAnalysis.reachMethod: We use mapped roads and paths to estimate journeys to the library, then count the people who live within that area. These figures estimate nearby residents, rather than library visits.
atlasAnalysis.populationYear: These estimates describe where people lived in {year}. The Population density layer uses different sources and may show a different year.
atlasAnalysis.reachSnap: Journey times are measured to a mapped road or path {distance} metres from the library's map pin.
atlasAnalysis.exportUnavailable: The export is unavailable. Try again.
atlasAnalysis.reachUnroutable: We couldn't find reliable walking or cycling routes to this library's map location.
atlasAnalysis.reachUnsupported: Reach isn't available for this library yet. We support fixed-location libraries in England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland where routing and population data are available. Planned, temporarily closed and permanently closed libraries are excluded.
atlasAnalysis.reachAvailability: Explore walking and cycling journeys to libraries across the UK.
atlasAnalysis.reachCountsExplanation: The 15-minute total includes everyone within 5 and 10 minutes. Don't add the rows together.
atlasAnalysis.reachOverlap: Someone may live within reach of more than one library. Adding library totals together would count some people more than once.
atlasAnalysis.reachSpeeds: We assume a walking speed of 5.1 km/h or 15 km/h on a hybrid bike.
atlasAnalysis.reachPopulationMethod: Population estimates come from a grid of 100-metre squares. If a square crosses the edge of the reachable area, we count only the share inside. The map shows a simpler outline than the one used for the calculation.
atlasAnalysis.reachMissingPopulation: We don't have enough population data for this area to estimate how many people could reach the library.

atlasInsights.additional: Extending the threshold from {from} to {to} minutes includes an estimated {residents} additional residents.
atlasInsights.beyond: An estimated {residents} residents remain beyond {minutes} minutes from the selected libraries.
atlasInsights.bandExplanation: Each resident appears in one band. Bar lengths show the share of the reporting population, not the length of the time interval.
atlasInsights.cumulativeExplanation: Residents within each threshold. These counts accumulate, so they must not be added together. Select a time to update the map.
atlasInsights.rounding: Resident estimates are rounded for display. Rounded bands may differ slightly from the rounded total.
atlasInsights.incompleteDistribution: The travel-time distribution needs complete routing and population data. Missing residents cannot be assigned to a band.
atlasInsights.contextExplanation: Compare modelled coverage within {minutes} minutes across groups of areas in this nation.
atlasInsights.groupExplanation: Deciles 1–2 contain the most deprived fifth of areas nationally; 9–10 contain the least deprived fifth. Groups contain different numbers of residents. All bars run from 0 to 100%.
atlasInsights.coverageByGroup: Percentage of each group’s modelled population within reach
atlasInsights.gap: Modelled coverage differs by {points} percentage points between {high} (highest) and {low} (lowest).
atlasInsights.outsideShareExplanation: Share beyond reach uses all reporting-area residents beyond the chosen time, including unclassified areas, as its denominator.
atlasInsights.contextLimits: These are area-based relative indices. They do not describe every resident, establish causation or support direct comparisons between nations. Unknown classifications stay separate from known groups.
atlasInsights.simdLimits: Overall SIMD includes access to services. That overlap can affect this comparison; it does not provide an independent test of the relationship between deprivation and accessibility. Income and employment domains are not included here.
atlasInsights.intersectionMethod: Full source deprivation boundaries partition the reporting area in the population grid’s equal-area projection. We allocate each cell’s modelled residents by its intersecting area, then intersect each group with the union of library catchments. Conflicting classifications and uncovered areas remain unclassified.
atlasInsights.populationMismatch: Population uses the {year} modelled grid. Index editions and boundary years differ; this is a spatial comparison, not a same-year population survey.
atlasInsights.incompleteContext: Community comparisons need complete routing and population coverage. No group percentages are shown for this incomplete calculation.
atlasInsights.insufficientContext: The community calculation could not be reconciled within its data or processing limits. Group percentages are unavailable; the service reach result remains available.
atlasInsights.unavailableContext: A compatible analytical deprivation edition is not installed for this reporting area. A map overlay alone cannot provide this comparison.
atlasInsights.singleTimeDistribution: This result covers {minutes} minutes only. Distinct journey-time bands need all four times, so they are not shown for this calculation.

atlasDataGaps.title: Data gap · {layer}
atlasDataGaps.unknown: Missing data means unknown, not zero or confirmed absence. Available data can still be explored.

reasons.administrativeUnavailable: Compatible administrative boundaries and population observations have not been joined for this country and level. An available resident grid can still be explored.
reasons.chooseEdition: More than one dataset may cover this location. Choose a country and edition before interpreting the layer.
reasons.notInstalled: No accepted dataset for this layer is installed in this environment.
reasons.outsideCoverage: This map location is outside the available coverage for this layer. Choose a listed country or edition to explore its data.
reasons.missingArea: The selected point has no matching reporting area in this dataset. It may be outside its boundaries or in an unpublished or missing area.
reasons.missingValue: The reporting area is known, but this dataset has no published value for it. The missing value must not be interpreted as zero.
reasons.missingPopulation: Population data is missing for the selected location or reporting area. A population or density estimate cannot be calculated there.
reasons.partialSource: The publisher or import records incomplete coverage for this dataset. The specific limitations are listed below.
reasons.unroutable: No usable walking or cycling route was found for this library location. A reachable-population estimate is unavailable; this does not mean nobody can reach the library.
reasons.unsupportedReach: Routing or population coverage is not available for this location. Reach cannot yet be calculated here.
reasons.partialReach: Some libraries or population cells could not be included. The result is partial and must not be read as complete service coverage.
reasons.communityUnavailable: Community comparisons are unavailable for this service area. A deprivation or car-access map does not by itself provide the analytical data needed for this calculation.
reasons.communityIncomplete: Community data does not fully cover the service area. Complete community comparisons cannot be calculated.
reasons.communityInsufficient: There is insufficient usable community data to produce a reliable comparison for this service area.
reasons.unconfirmedAccess: Some library records do not confirm all selected accessibility features. Unconfirmed information does not mean a feature is absent.
reasons.unverifiedDirectory: The library directory has not been verified as complete for this area. Counts and comparisons describe recorded libraries; missing records do not prove that an area has no library.
reasons.temporaryFailure: The data service could not load this result. This is a temporary retrieval failure, not evidence that the location has no data.

atlasDensity.inspectPrompt: Select the map to inspect the count and area of a cell. Library pins open the individual record.

atlasDensity.coarsened: Showing coarser cells to include every matching record within the response limit. Zoom in for finer detail.
atlasDensity.smoothNote: Smoothing spreads each cell’s concentration into neighbouring cells. Its colours are relative; selected-cell figures always describe the original, unsmoothed grid. Detail controls the smoothing scale.
atlasDensity.gridNote: Each cell shows recorded libraries divided by its geographic area. Empty cells are transparent. Detail follows zoom unless you choose a preferred resolution.
atlasDensity.filters: Library, service, opening-hours and accessibility filters apply. Counts include complete cells around the map edge, so edge-cell counts can exceed the number visible inside the view.
atlasDensity.method: Published library coordinates are counted in geographic cells. Density is the count divided by the spherical cell area, including water, multiplied by 100. Automatic detail changes cell size, while a fixed colour scale keeps rates comparable.
atlasDensity.coverage: This describes the recorded index. No matching records does not prove there is no library. It does not measure residents, travel time, service quality or library use.

atlas.the_library_access_comparison_couldn_t_l: The library access comparison couldn’t load.
atlas.darker_means_more_recorded_libraries_for: Darker means more recorded libraries for each person.
atlas.no_libraries_are_indexed_here_yet_this_d: No libraries are indexed here yet. This does not mean there are no libraries.
atlas.a_matching_population_estimate_is_unavai: A matching population estimate is unavailable.
atlas.fewer_than_five_records_are_indexed_here: Fewer than five records are indexed here. The comparison may change substantially as records are added.
atlas.no_indexed_libraries_match_these_filters: No indexed libraries match these filters. People per library has no finite value.
atlas.under_100_000_residents_a_single_library: Under 100,000 residents: a single library can change the rate substantially.
atlas.this_compares_recorded_libraries_with_th: This compares recorded libraries with the people living in each area. It doesn’t show whether people can reach a library, and low figures can mean missing records. Each rate covers its whole area.
atlas.missing_libraries_can_make_these_figures: Missing libraries can make these figures look lower than actual provision. Adding confirmed library records improves the comparison.
atlas.no_areas_match_your_search_in_this_scope: No areas match your search in this scope.
atlas.select_one_on_the_map_search_above_or_ch: Select one on the map, search above, or choose from Compare.
atlas.areas_with_the_fewest_recorded_libraries: Areas with the fewest recorded libraries per resident
atlas.the_layer_uses_reporting_area_boundaries: The layer uses reporting-area boundaries, generalised for display. Library counts and population denominators cover each whole area, wherever you move or zoom the map.
atlas.libraries_per_100_000_residents_matching: Libraries per 100,000 residents = matching recorded libraries ÷ resident population × 100,000.
atlas.people_per_library_resident_population_m: People per library = resident population ÷ matching recorded libraries.
atlas.only_libraries_that_confirm_every_select: Only libraries that confirm every selected feature. With no features selected, any recorded accessibility feature qualifies.
atlas.confirmed_matches_are_solid_blue_other_r: Confirmed matches are solid blue. Other records are hollow amber. Cluster labels show matches / total records.
atlas.only_records_that_do_not_confirm_every_s: Only records that do not confirm every selected feature. These may include partial records.
atlas.a_gap_in_our_records_does_not_prove_a_fe: A gap in our records does not prove a feature is absent.
atlas.turn_on_the_layer_or_choose_a_feature_to: Turn on the layer or choose a feature to see map coverage.
atlas.browse_all_features_a_free_account_lets_: Browse all features. A free account lets you apply your choices to the map.
atlas.sign_in_to_apply_accessibility_features: Sign in to apply accessibility features
atlas.filled_pins_show_recorded_matches_hollow: Filled pins show recorded matches; hollow pins show details not recorded yet. Cluster labels show recorded / total, for example 3/5.
atlas.not_recorded_yet_doesn_t_mean_inaccessib: Not recorded yet doesn’t mean inaccessible.
atlas.check_with_the_library_before_you_visit: Check with the library before you visit.
atlas.filled_pins_confirm_every_chosen_feature: Filled pins confirm every chosen feature. Hollow pins mean our record does not confirm every chosen feature. Missing information does not mean a library is inaccessible. Check with the library before visiting.
atlas.check_the_library_s_website_then_open_a_: Check the library’s website, then open a library record to suggest a correction with confirmed details.
atlas.see_a_gap_on_the_map: See a gap on the map?
atlas.add_a_missing_library_or_fix_one_that_s_: Add a missing library or fix one that’s out of date. Accepted changes are credited to you, and your first one unlocks Reach.

atlas.the_export_didn_t_finish_check_your_conn: The export didn’t finish. Check your connection and try again.
atlas.only_libraries_with_a_recorded_founding_: Only libraries with a recorded founding year are shown when this is set.

atlas.no_mobile_stops_match_this_view: No mobile stops match this view.
atlas.auto_uses_local_areas_when_you_zoom_into: Auto uses local areas when you zoom into the UK. Local comparisons currently cover UK districts; countries cover the world.
atlas.counts_use_published_records_with_usable: Counts use published records with usable map pins. Each mobile service counts once at its depot, never once per stop. Also follows your Filters. Planned libraries and permanent closures are excluded.
atlas.density_opening_hours_and_more_live_in_t: Density, opening hours and more live in the Layers tab.
atlas.the_timetable_could_not_be_loaded_open_t: The timetable could not be loaded. Open the library page to try again.
atlas.no_visits_scheduled_for_this_stop: No visits scheduled for this stop.
atlas.no_visits_scheduled_in_the_next_six_mont: No visits scheduled in the next six months.
atlas.stops_and_times_appear_here_once_the_lib: Stops and times appear here once the library adds them.
atlas.method_41: Counts follow your Filters, chosen library types and enabled accessibility selection. Only published records with usable map coordinates are counted. Planned libraries and permanent closures are excluded. Each mapped mobile service counts once at its depot, never once per stop.
atlas.method_43: The library index is incomplete. Low rates can mean missing records. This does not measure travel time, opening capacity, eligibility or quality. Academic and restricted libraries may serve a different population. Five indexed records do not establish good or complete record coverage.
atlas.method_45: Hatching means one to four libraries are indexed before filtering. Grey means missing population or no indexed baseline. Zero matching libraries is a valid filtered count, not proof of no local provision; people per library then has no finite value.
atlas.method_46: Fixed colour bands stay comparable as you filter. People-per-library band limits are rounded reciprocals of the per-100k scale. Histogram bars count areas with a rate, including those with few indexed records. Rankings include areas with at least five indexed records and 20,000 residents.
atlas.method_47: Scope changes which whole areas are included in the analysis and CSV. In map view includes areas whose geographic bounds intersect the view; it does not clip the population or library counts.
atlas.method_95: With nothing chosen, any recorded accessibility detail counts. With features chosen, a library must record all of them. Not recorded yet includes records with no details and records that confirm only some chosen features.
atlas.method_96: The index records confirmed features. Missing confirmation does not distinguish unknown information from an absent feature, and does not establish that a library is inaccessible. Confirm arrangements with the library before visiting.
